ideal: Alert: Apple rose 3.56% while the S&P 500 fell 0.6%, with no filing to explain it yet. Broadcom filed its 10-Q quarterly report and an S-4 registration, which is often tied to a deal; link both.

verdicts.note: Covers all three items with correct numbers and a hedged, plain explanation of the S-4, though the S-4 line is a bit wordy.
verdicts.answer:
Apple rose 3.56% while the S&P 500 fell 0.6%, no filing explains it yet.
Broadcom filed its 10-Q, the quarterly report: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000173016826000080/avgo-20260802.htm
Broadcom also filed an S-4, which registers new shares or securities, often for a merger or an exchange offer. Worth a look to see what deal it covers: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000119312526387881/d154803ds4.htm

verdicts.note: Complete, but it states the S-4 is for a business combination as fact, and the single paragraph is harder to scan than one line per company.
verdicts.answer: Apple rose 3.56% while the S&P 500 fell 0.6% — no filing explains it yet. Broadcom filed a 10-Q quarterly report (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000173016826000080/avgo-20260802.htm) and an S-4 registration statement for securities to be issued in a business combination (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000119312526387881/d154803ds4.htm).

verdicts.note: Leaves out Broadcom's 10-Q and S-4, and the Apple line is grammatically clumsy.
verdicts.answer: Apple rose 3.56% vs S&P 500 fell 0.6% no filing explains it yet

verdicts.note: Concise and complete, though calling the S-4 'stock being issued in a deal' is slightly more definite than the evidence supports.
verdicts.answer:
Apple rose 3.56% while the S&P 500 fell 0.6% — no filing explains it yet.
Broadcom filed its quarterly report (10-Q): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000173016826000080/avgo-20260802.htm
Broadcom also filed an S-4 registration statement (stock being issued in a deal): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000119312526387881/d154803ds4.htm

verdicts.note: Accurate and complete, but the S-4 is labelled only 'registration statement' with no plain explanation of why it matters.
